aggregation: Median per-run critical throughput, timely throughput and successful p95 (not merged global percentile). Pooled rejection/error percentages. Mean SQL wait is total WaitDuration delta / WaitCount delta, including drain. Job counts are median per phase including drain. Lifetime trace is one named run, sampled about100ms.
limitations: Short local experiments on one macOS host/Podman VM; not production capacity, OOM prevention, engine-native PostgreSQL enforcement or cluster coordination. Pool signals can oscillate and sampled values can miss transients. Three outside consumers leave one real connection; a SQL admission ceiling of4 still permits waiting even with background restricted. Driver completion is not proof server execution stopped after ambiguous network failure.
